environment.cpp_sha256: CommonCrypto; current harness requires macOS SDK

behavior_changes: Removed commitmentValueZero from the real validator and stateless composition; retained its mathematical reference predicate and theorem without a consensus-row tag.
Ordered stage selects the highest matching output, checks reserved-item shape first, then SHA256d(witness root ++ actual reserved item).
Malformed reserved stacks reject bad-witness-nonce-size; hash mismatch rejects bad-witness-merkle-match; witness without an active selected commitment rejects unexpected-witness.
Stage stays before full weight, preserving earlier CheckBlock errors. Amount/running-fee/coinbase-reward checks remain enforced separately.

proofs.actual_coinbase_value_invariance: For arbitrary replacement f and remaining transactions, replacing amounts in the actual first transaction and selected coinbase argument leaves witness validation unchanged. This does not claim overall block acceptance is value-invariant.
proofs.public_dataflow: Existing sigop-stage inversion is strengthened with the successful witness stage for either public entry; the new witness theorem exposes this stage and the Boolean commitment predicate.
contract_changes: Removed the false zero-value conjunct from StatelessRows/statelessValidate; the correct nonce requirement remains implied by the exact commitment predicate and separately ordered in execution.
Weight/BIP30 rejection theorems no longer require unnecessary value/nonce assumptions; successful commitment implies nonce shape.
Commitment-preempts-weight equation exposes the ordered witness stage so its precise error taxonomy replaces the old generic reason. PDW53 commitment-failure-ne-weight statement remains unchanged.
Existing fee, sequence, sigop and ledger contracts remain proved.
